name: vincetrade
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #2: HE NEVER PLAYED FOR US 🎮🏀 We traded Vince Carter to New Jersey. The biggest name we got back never played a game for us.

• Dec 17, 2004: Vince to the Nets for Alonzo Mourning, Eric Williams, Aaron Williams and 2 first-round picks
• Mourning never reported and was bought out
• Vince's last 20 games with us: 15.9 PPG. Rest of that season in New Jersey: 27.5 PPG
• Nov 2, 2024: his No. 15 became the first jersey we ever retired

Worst trade we ever made, or did Vince force our hand?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #3 drops tomorrow night. Follow so you don't miss it.

beats.head: HE NEVER PLAYED FOR US
beats.name: VINCE
beats.vo: We traded Vince Carter. The biggest name we got back never played a single game for us.
beats.dlg: WE TRADE VINCE CARTER|TO NEW JERSEY.

beats.head: WHAT WE GOT
beats.name: VINCE
beats.vo: For Vince, we got Alonzo Mourning, Eric Williams, Aaron Williams and two first-round picks. Mourning never even reported.
beats.dlg: WE GET MOURNING, 2 FIRSTS.|MOURNING NEVER SHOWS UP.

beats.head: THE END HERE
beats.name: VINCE
beats.vo: His last twenty games with us: fifteen point nine points a night.

beats.head: IN NEW JERSEY
beats.name: VINCE
beats.vo: The rest of that same season in New Jersey? Twenty-seven point five a night.
beats.dlg: SAME SEASON IN JERSEY:|27.5 PPG IN 57 GAMES.

beats.head: COMING HOME
beats.name: VINCE
beats.vo: Twenty years later, all was forgiven. In twenty twenty-four, his number fifteen became the first jersey we ever retired.
beats.dlg: 2024: NO. 15 IS THE FIRST|JERSEY WE EVER RETIRE.

beats.head: THE VERDICT
beats.vo: Did we win this trade? W or L. Case three, tomorrow night.
beats.dlg: DID WE WIN THIS TRADE?|W OR L? CASE #3: TOMORROW NIGHT.

facts.claim: On December 17, 2004 (Dec 17) Carter was traded to the New Jersey Nets for Alonzo Mourning, Aaron Williams, Eric Williams and two (2) first-round picks; 2004-05 with New Jersey: 57 games, 27.5 PPG; on November 2, 2024 (Nov 2) the Raptors retired his No. 15, the first Raptors player to have his jersey retired
Mourning never reported to the Raptors (0 games played) and was bought out on February 11, 2005
